mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume ( recruitment_request_id, job_title, applicant_name, contact_phone, email, education, work_experience, resume_file_name, resume_file_url, status, interview_status, create_time, create_user_id, create_user_name, update_time, update_user_id, update_user_name ) VALUES ( #{recruitmentRequestId}, #{jobTitle}, #{applicantName}, #{contactPhone}, #{email}, #{education}, #{workExperience}, #{resumeFileName}, #{resumeFileUrl}, #{status}, #{interviewStatus}, NOW(), #{createUserId}, #{createUserName}, NOW(), #{updateUserId}, #{updateUserName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE resume SET recruitment_request_id = #{recruitmentRequestId}, job_title = #{jobTitle}, applicant_name = #{applicantName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, email = #{email}, education = #{education}, work_experience = #{workExperience}, resume_file_name = #{resumeFileName}, resume_file_url = #{resumeFileUrl}, status = #{status}, interview_status = #{interviewStatus}, update_time = NOW(), update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName} WHERE resume_id = #{resumeId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resume ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM resume WHERE recruitment_request_id = #{recruitmentRequestId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM resume WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
